diagnostics.summary: Rule with path '/Rep/Other/AltComp': The error field '/Rep/Rows/Alt' is not in the rule group, but the condition specifies iteration. [MVK_ERROR_FIELD_NOT_IN_RULEGROUP]
diagnostics.fix: Place the error field inside every repeatable group the rule iterates over. The condition references a per-row field, so the rule iterates and its error field must live in that repeatable group — either pick an error field inside it, or make the rule whole-document by aggregating the per-row operand (e.g. Sum(Group*/Field)) so it no longer iterates.
diagnostics.explain: A rule's iteration scope is the set of repeatable groups among the fields it references (including the error field); the error field must lie in every repeatably-referenced group, otherwise the per-row error has nowhere to attach.
